story:
Stubbs Landscaping, LLC is a full-service landscape design, installation, and maintenance company founded by Justin Rinehimer in 2010. Justin started doing landscaping jobs at sixteen to earn spending money. After considering a career in chemical engineering, he decided to pursue horticulture instead and earned his degree from Penn College. Today he is a business owner with nine full-time employees and a crew carrying more than thirty years of combined experience designing and constructing outdoor spaces across Luzerne County.

We are a one-stop shop for the backyard. Hardscaping, landscaping, outdoor living, custom decks, plunge pools, and lawn health are all handled in-house, which means a patio, the wall holding the grade behind it, the plantings and lighting around it, and the deck it connects to get designed as one project rather than coordinated across four different contractors. From a single walkway to a full outdoor living area with a kitchen, a fire feature, and a pool, our team works to make your vision the thing that actually gets built.

Every design comes with full 3D renderings and walkthrough videos. It is hard to make design decisions in the dark, and our rendering service lets you envision the space before the work starts — get a feel for the look and the flow so you can be sure everything is as you pictured it. Changing your mind on screen costs nothing. Changing it after a wall is built costs a great deal.

How we behave on your property is written down, not implied. We arrive in branded company trucks and attire so you know who is in the driveway. We run a clean-site checklist at the end of every day. We keep a smoke-free policy on your property. And if a neighbour raises a concern while we are working, we handle it rather than leaving it to you. Our reputation for respectful work is growing across Northeastern Pennsylvania, and we would like you to experience it too.
